cases.prompt: Invoke /God with /pe, /4629, /ITQE and /karma when two aliases point to the same authority.
assertions: Construct one acyclic execution plan and invoke each canonical owner once per phase.
Preserve source constraints and report alias collisions without rewriting unrelated skills.
cases.grader: Inspect the resolved DAG, version hashes, actual tool invocations and recorded collision decisions.

cases.prompt: Run /God on a website whose required generated manuscript source is unavailable.
assertions: Do not fabricate source JSON or bypass preflight.
Mark build and deployment BLOCKED, and do not claim two clean passes.
cases.grader: Compare build logs, source inventory, release status and changed files against observed evidence.

cases.prompt: Run /God on a document with a missing appendix and one broken equation reference.
assertions: Detect source-to-output manifest omissions and mathematical references.
Repair only with verified source material and rerender before release.
cases.grader: Inspect complete manifests, exported artifact, equation checks and two independently recorded QA passes.
